name: Sales — post engager
description: For people who liked or commented on a post about your problem space. The trigger is fresh and specific, so this sequence moves faster and references the post directly in the first touch.
audience: Lists built from `post.engagers` on a post — yours or someone else's — that is about the problem you solve.

variants: {{firstName|Hi}} — we both ended up in the comments on that thread. Clearly a shared preoccupation. Connecting so I can follow what you're doing at {{company|your company}}.
Hi {{firstName|there}} — saw you engaging with the same thread I was. Would be good to connect with someone else who cares about this.
Thanks {{firstName|there}}. Since you were on that thread — how are you handling it at {{company|your company}}? Everyone we speak to seems to be doing it manually and quietly hating it.
Genuinely curious, {{firstName|there}}: is this a live problem at {{company|your company}} or were you just enjoying the argument? Both are valid answers.
{{firstName|Hi}} — we built something for exactly this. Happy to show you in ten minutes, or send a two-minute recording if that's easier. Your call.
If it is a live problem, {{firstName|there}}, I can show you what we did about it in ten minutes. If it isn't, tell me and I'll go away.
Last one, {{firstName|there}} — I'll assume the timing's wrong. If it changes at {{company|your company}}, you know where I am.
Closing this off, {{firstName|there}}. Thanks for the thread either way — it was a better discussion than most.
